When you enrol on Get Chartered AI you get immediate access to a complete APC preparation programme built around how assessors actually score — not just what the competency says. That means 12 structured modules covering every mandatory competency and a dedicated pathway module built for yours. 50 assessor-led technical questions specific to your pathway — with model answers, referral warnings, and challenge questions. Michael, your AI APC coach, available 24/7 in Tutor Mode and Assessor Mode. A 60-minute AI-scored mock interview. Industry Briefing updated every assessment window. CPD log and submission checklist. Everything from day one. No waiting, no setup.

Been referred?

The APC Referred — Confidence Reset gives you six specialist modules built for candidates who need to understand why they were referred, rebuild their competency answers, and perform under pressure second time around. Includes an optional Case Study Review where Michael coaches you directly on your resubmission draft.

Moving into Year Two?

The APC Year Two Readiness Review benchmarks exactly where you are against your pathway competency requirements — identifying gaps while there is still time to address them, with a personalised Michael readiness report to guide your Year Two development plan.

Everything is available from day one. No waiting, no setup.

About the Platform

Built for aspiring
Chartered Surveyors

Get Chartered AI — the structured APC preparation platform. The platform doesn't just give you content to read. It builds the way you think, speak and evidence your experience.

Get Chartered AI is a structured APC preparation platform built by Chartered Surveyors who have been through the process themselves. Twelve modules covering every mandatory competency. Sprint-specific coaching for candidates preparing under pressure. Six specialist modules for referred candidates. All 22 RICS pathways supported from day one.

The platform doesn't just give you content to read. It builds the way you think, speak and evidence your experience — because that's what the APC actually tests. Most candidates who are referred know their subject. What separates those who pass is the ability to demonstrate it clearly, under pressure, in the format assessors score.

About Michael

Michael is not a chatbox. He is a coaching presence built into every competency module. In Tutor Mode he meets you where you are — helping you shape real experience into competency evidence and naming the level of every answer. In Assessor Mode he challenges you exactly as the panel will — directly, without softening, with the follow-up questions you were not expecting.See Michael in action →

Which RICS pathway are you on?

We'll personalise your experience around your pathway

Infrastructure is not a standalone RICS APC pathway — please select the pathway that matches your role, typically one of the following depending on your specialism: Project Management (infrastructure projects, programme delivery), Quantity Surveying & Construction (cost management on infrastructure schemes), Building Surveying (building/structures elements), Planning & Development (infrastructure planning, DCO work), Geospatial (utilities, mapping, land referencing).

We use browser storage to keep you logged in and save your course progress. No advertising or tracking cookies are used. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Submission Checklist

This checklist is a preparation guide only. Always verify your submission requirements and deadlines directly with RICS. Get Chartered AI is not responsible for submission compliance or deadline management.

📝 Case Study Review — Michael's Coaching

Paste your case study draft below. Michael will review it and give you specific coaching feedback.

RICS Case Study Requirements

Your case study is strictly limited to 3,000 words maximum. This includes headings and subheadings but excludes the cover page, contents page and appendices.

The recommended structure is:

  • Introduction — approximately 400 words
  • Approach — approximately 1,000 words
  • Achievements — approximately 1,200 words
  • Conclusion — approximately 400 words

Source: RICS APC submissions and assessment guidance

This is AI-generated coaching feedback to help you develop your case study. It is not an official RICS assessment and does not predict your outcome. Always review feedback with your counsellor before submission. Get Chartered AI accepts no responsibility for APC submission outcomes.

Case Study Review

AI Coaching on your Case Study Draft

Paste your case study draft and Michael will give you structured coaching feedback — not a mark, not a score, but specific guidance on what is working, what to strengthen and the questions your assessor is likely to ask.

RICS Case Study Requirements

Your case study is strictly limited to 3,000 words maximum. This includes headings and subheadings but excludes the cover page, contents page and appendices.

The recommended structure is:

  • Introduction — approximately 400 words
  • Approach — approximately 1,000 words
  • Achievements — approximately 1,200 words
  • Conclusion — approximately 400 words

What Michael reviews

  • What is working well in your draft
  • What to strengthen before submission
  • Questions your assessor is likely to ask based on what you have written
  • One thing to discuss with your counsellor
Important: This is AI-generated coaching feedback to help you develop your case study. It is not an official RICS assessment and does not predict your outcome.
